en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Whichever Momin walks regarding a need of his brother, but does not advise him, so he has betrayed Allahazwj and Hisazwj Rasoolsaww’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama’a who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Any believer who works to help his brother (in belief) but is not sincere enough has breached his trust with Allah and the Messenger of Allah.’”
